name: omnilab/rhea
description: Omnilab Rhea: a biochemical reaction by any of its four Rhea ids (18157, 18160) or its KEGG reaction (R00200) - its equation, status, balance, transport, sides and their participants, citations - its quartet and KEGG reaction as identifiers, its ChEBI participants, EC numbers, GO term, Reactome events and the reviewed UniProt proteins that catalyse it as related things; a search; through Rhea's SPARQL endpoint and REST search, no key.
